basic_details.job_title: Bharathidasan University Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Project Assistant, Research Associate II and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Research Associate II, Project Associate I, Project Assistant

qualification.details: Research Associate II: Ph.D. in Microbiology / Biotechnology / Life Sciences or equivalent from a recognized University. Three years of experience in cyanobacterial / microalgal related research and development in industrial / academic institutions and proven track record of scientific activities in the form of publications is mandatory. Prior research experience in cyanobacterial / microalgal cultivation, downstream processing, and characterization will be preferred. Project Associate I: M.Sc. in Microbiology / Biotechnology / Life Sciences or equivalent. Prior research experience in cyanobacterial / microalgal isolation, cultivation, and mass cultivation will be preferred. Project Assistant: B.Tech / M.tech Biotechnology / Integrated Biotechnology / B.Sc., / M.Sc. in Botany / Zoology / Microbiology / Biotechnology / Any life sciences degree. Proven experience on microalgal / cyanobacterial culture purification and maintenance is preferred.

salary_details.details: Research Associate II: Rs. 71,980/ - pm Project Associate I: Rs. 29,500/ - pm Project Assistant: Rs. 23,600/ - pm

Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 27-08-2026.

content_sections.heading: Bharathidasan University Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for Research Associate II, 1 for Project Associate I, and 1 for Project Assistant.

content_sections.heading: Bharathidasan University Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Research Associate II: Ph.D. in Microbiology / Biotechnology / Life Sciences or equivalent from a recognized University. Three years of experience in cyanobacterial / microalgal related research and development in industrial / academic institutions and proven track record of scientific activities in the form of publications is mandatory. Prior research experience in cyanobacterial / microalgal cultivation, downstream processing, and characterization will be preferred. Project Associate I: M.Sc. in Microbiology / Biotechnology / Life Sciences or equivalent. Prior research experience in cyanobacterial / microalgal isolation, cultivation, and mass cultivation will be preferred. Project Assistant: B.Tech / M.tech Biotechnology / Integrated Biotechnology / B.Sc., / M.Sc. in Botany / Zoology / Microbiology / Biotechnology / Any life sciences degree. Proven experience on microalgal / cyanobacterial culture purification and maintenance is preferred.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 27-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Bharathidasan University recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to send your application via email for the Bharathidasan University recruitment is 27-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate-II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate-II post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification for the Project Assistant position is a B.Tech / M.tech Biotechnology / Integrated Biotechnology / B.Sc., / M.Sc. in Botany / Zoology / Microbiology / Biotechnology / Any life sciences degree.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Associate-I post is Rs. 29,500/- pm, which includes basic pay and HRA.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will be based on a Walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the Walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: The Walk-in interview will be held at the National Facility for Marine Cyanobacteria.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required to be carried for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring attested copies of mark sheets, degree certificates, proof of experience, and original certificates/documents for verification.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be provided for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, TA/DA will not be provided for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. What is the total number of vacancies in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies are available across the three posts: Research Associate-II, Project Associate-I, and Project Assistant.
